#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;

long long powMod(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

long long modInverse(long long n) {
    return powMod(n, MOD - 2);
}

struct Node {
    int c50, c100, b, n;
    long long am;
    std::vector<Node*> s;
    Node(int c50_, int c100_, int b_) : c50(c50_), c100(c100_), b(b_), n(0), am(0) {}
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    vector<long long> fact(51, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < 51; i++) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
    }

    long long comb[51][51];
    for (int i = 0; i <= 50; i++) {
        comb[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            long long denom = (fact[j] * fact[i - j]) % MOD;
            comb[i][j] = (fact[i] * modInverse(denom)) % MOD;
        }
    }

    int totalCards, maxCards;
    cin >> totalCards >> maxCards;
    int c50Count = 0, c100Count = 0;
    vector<int> values(totalCards);
    for (int i = 0; i < totalCards; i++) {
        cin >> values[i];
        if (values[i] == 100) c100Count++;
        else c50Count++;
    }

    vector<vector<vector<Node>>> nodes(c50Count + 1, vector<vector<Node>>(c100Count + 1, vector<Node>(2, Node(0,0,0))));
    for (int i = 0; i <= c50Count; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= c100Count; j++) {
            nodes[i][j][0] = Node(i, j, 0);
            nodes[i][j][1] = Node(i, j, 1);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i <= c50Count; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= c100Count; j++) {
            int max50Pick = std::min(maxCards / 50, i);
            int max100Pick = std::min(maxCards / 100, j);
            for (int x = max100Pick; x >= 0; x--) {
                for (int y = std::min(max50Pick, (maxCards - 100 * x) / 50); y >= 0; y--) {
                    if (x == 0 && y == 0) continue;
                    nodes[i][j][0].s.push_back(&nodes[i - y][j - x][1]);
                    nodes[i - y][j - x][1].s.push_back(&nodes[i][j][0]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    std::queue<Node*> q;
    nodes[c50Count][c100Count][0].n = 1;
    nodes[c50Count][c100Count][0].am = 1;
    q.push(&nodes[c50Count][c100Count][0]);

    while (!q.empty()) {
        Node* current = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (auto neighbor : current->s) {
            if (neighbor->n == 0 || neighbor->n == current->n + 1) {
                long long p1, p2;
                if (current->b == 0) {
                    p1 = comb[current->c50][abs(current->c50 - neighbor->c50)];
                    p2 = comb[current->c100][abs(current->c100 - neighbor->c100)];
                } else {
                    p1 = comb[c50Count - current->c50][abs(current->c50 - neighbor->c50)];
                    p2 = comb[c100Count - current->c100][abs(current->c100 - neighbor->c100)];
                }
                neighbor->am = (neighbor->am + (current->am * (p1 * p2 % MOD)) % MOD) % MOD;
                if (neighbor->n == 0) {
                    neighbor->n = current->n + 1;
                    q.push(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << (nodes[0][0][1].n - 1) << "\n" << nodes[0][0][1].am << "\n";

    return 0;
}
